item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 19/Sep/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will be mainly fine and very hot over southern China in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, winds will be weak over Guangdong. Showers triggered by high temperatures will affect the region. A weak northeast monsoon is expected to affect the coast of southeastern China in the latter part of this week. A broad trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the vicinity of the central part of the South China Sea and the Philippines over the weekend and early next week.
